target_claim: For an odd prime p and d_1>2 with p-1=floor((p-1)/d_1)d_1+s_1, if floor((p-1)/d_1)+s_1 >= d_1-1, then every allowed binomial X^{d_1}+bX has theta-adic exponential-sum valuation floor((p-1)/d_1)+s_1.
source_quote:
\item[{ f b.}] If $\lfloor \frac{p-1}{d_1}\rfloor+s_1\geq d_1-1$ then
$$\nu_\theta(S(X^{d_1}+bX))=\lfloor \frac{p-1}{d_1}\rfloor+s_1.$$
 In particular, $p>V_f\geq  \lfloor\frac{p-1}{d_1}\rfloor+s_1+1$.
